sql: SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName, sum(CASE WHEN sp.ScenarioKey = 1 THEN sp.Amount ELSE 0 END) as actual, sum(CASE WHEN sp.ScenarioKey = 2 THEN sp.Amount ELSE 0 END) as budget FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan sp JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON sp.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey JOIN retail.DimAccount a ON sp.AccountKey = a.AccountKey WHERE a.AccountName = 'Sale Revenue' AND toYear(sp.DateKey) = 2009 GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
